resolved.title: 函数参数
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Function Arguments[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

There are two ways to pass arguments to a function as the function is being called.

[b]By value:[/b] This method copies the argument's actual value into the function's formal parameter. Here, we can make changes to the parameter within the function without having any effect on the argument.

[b]By reference:[/b] This method copies the argument's reference into the formal parameter. Within the function, the reference is used to access the actual argument used in the call. This means that any change made to the parameter affects the argument.
[note]By default, C++ uses call[b] by value[/b] to pass arguments.[/note]
resolved.description_en:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Function Arguments[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

There are two ways to pass arguments to a function as the function is being called.

[b]By value:[/b] This method copies the argument's actual value into the function's formal parameter. Here, we can make changes to the parameter within the function without having any effect on the argument.

[b]By reference:[/b] This method copies the argument's reference into the formal parameter. Within the function, the reference is used to access the actual argument used in the call. This means that any change made to the parameter affects the argument.
[note]By default, C++ uses call[b] by value[/b] to pass arguments.[/note]

content.text:
当调用函数时，有两种向函数传递参数的方式：

- **值传递**：该方法把参数的实际值**复制**给函数的形式参数。在这种情况下，修改函数内的形式参数对实际参数没有影响。

- **引用传递**：该方法把参数的**引用复制**给形式参数。在函数内，该引用用于访问调用中要用到的实际参数。这意味着，**修改形式参数会影响实际参数**。
content.text_html:
There are two ways to pass arguments to a function as the function is being called.

By value: This method copies the argument's actual value into the function's formal parameter. Here, we can make changes to the parameter within the function without having any effect on the argument.

By reference: This method copies the argument's reference into the formal parameter. Within the function, the reference is used to access the actual argument used in the call. This means that any change made to the parameter affects the argument.

有两种方法可以在函数被调用时向函数传递参数。

通过值：这种方法将参数的实际值复制到函数的形式参数中。在这里，我们可以在函数中对参数进行修改，而不会对参数产生任何影响。

通过引用：该方法将参数的引用复制到形式参数中。在函数中，该引用被用来访问调用中使用的实际参数。这意味着对参数所做的任何改变都会影响到该参数。

content.text: 默认情况下，C++使用按**值传递**来传递参数。
content.text_html:
By default, C++ uses call** by value** to pass arguments.

默认情况下，C++使用call** by value**来传递参数。

resolved.title: 引用传递

content.text:
**引用传递**将一个参数**内存地址**复制到形式参数中。在函数内部，该地址用来访问调用中使用的实际参数。这意味着对参数所做的改变会影响到该参数。

通过引用传递值，参数的**指针**就像其他值一样传递到函数中。
content.text_html:
Pass-by-reference copies an argument's address into the formal parameter. Inside the function, the address is used to access the actual argument used in the call. This means that changes made to the parameter affect the argument. To pass the value by reference, argument **pointers **are passed to the functions just like any other value.

通过引用将一个参数的地址复制到形式参数中。在函数内部，该地址被用来访问调用中使用的实际参数。这意味着对参数所做的改变会影响到该参数。 为了通过引用传递数值，参数的指针就像其他数值一样被传递到函数中。

content.text:
正如你所看到的，我们使用**地址操作符**`&`直接将变量传递给了函数。

函数声明中，该函数接收一个**指针**作为其参数（使用**操作符**`*`定义）。
content.text_html:
As you can see, we passed the variable directly to the function using the address-of operator &. The function declaration says that the function takes a **pointer as its parameter (defined using the *** operator).

正如你所看到的，我们使用地址操作符&直接将变量传递给了函数。 函数声明中说，该函数接收一个指针作为其参数（使用*操作符定义）。

content.text: 因此，该函数实际上已经改变了参数的值，因为通过指针访问它。
content.text_html:
As a result, the function has actually changed the argument's value, as accessed it via the pointer.

resolved.title: 网络带宽提升
resolved.problem_statement_md:
中国移动正在普惠大众，使用户的网络带宽成倍增长。

输入2个数字：
1. 当前用户网络带宽`megabytes`(int 类型)
2. 带宽提升的倍数(int类型)

通过完成函数`promotion`并调用它来修复程序，该函数有一个**指针参数**，表示当前带宽，并在函数中处理输入得到的提升倍数，函数内直接修改网络带宽变量`megabytes`。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Pass by Reference with Pointers[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

You operate a mobile provider running a promotion that multiplies a user's internet bandwidth.
Fix the program by completing the function and calling it, so that the given megabyte outputs before and after the promotion work correctly.
The multiplier is taken as input inside the multiplier function.

[b]Sample Input[/b]
5
2

[b]Sample Output[/b]
Before the promotion: 5
After the promotion: 10

[b]Explanation[/b]
The first input is the count of megabytes, the second is multiplier.
The first outputted line represents the count of megabytes before the function-multiplier call, and the second one - after.
[note]Use [b]address-of operator &[/b] in function call.[/note]
resolved.hint_md: 在函数调用中使用**地址操作符**`&`。

resolved.title: 总结
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Summary[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

[b]Passing by value:[/b] This method copies the actual value of an argument into the formal parameter of the function. In this case, changes made to the parameter inside the function have no effect on the argument.

[b]Passing by reference:[/b] This method copies the reference of an argument into the formal parameter. Inside the function, the reference is used to access the actual argument used in the call. So, changes made to the parameter also affect the argument.
[note]In general, passing by value is faster and more effective. Pass by reference when your function needs to modify the argument, or when you need to pass a data type, that uses a lot of memory and is expensive to copy.[/note]

一般来说，按值传递更快、更有效。

但当你的函数需要修改参数时，或者当你需要传递一个数据类型时，通过引用来传递，可以节约内存，因为按值传递复制成本很高。
